system.description: Years ago by a screech. You were injured at Third Black Fire. What injuries did you sustain? How long did it take you to recover? You were accused of a crime based in part on the testimony of Frederick Grosz. What did Grosz say? Did he lie for you? You are no longer a member of the army of Averland. Why not? Were you only ever a mercenary orally? Graf Friedrich von Kaufman is a patron of Marcus Baerfaust. Some people say he was a hero, keeping the Mad Count, if he'd wanted to. What is your opinion of him? Others say he could have saved Rolf, but he didn't. What do you say? The criminals in Averheim are starting to bow down to a new boss, the “man in the black hood.” People who won’t comply with the new order are starting to turn up dead. Has anyone you know been killed? Do you have an opinion on “the man in the black hood”? After your injury, you spent some time in a Shallyan temple hospice, where you met Clothilde von Alptraum, a noblewoman from Averland who was donating her time and money to the hospice. What is your opinion of Gravin Clothilde? You are eager to speak with the Foreign Messenger player. Why? Is his or her Masteran character wishes you didn't, but you've agreed quiet...for now. One day down by the docks, you realized you were missing your bag, that contained several pages of your sizable amount of money. You can't prove it, but you think the Criminal character might be involved its disappearance. Why did you leave? Your father had a business arrangement with Graf Friedrich von Kaufman. What was your relationship to him or her? Someone in your family proposed marriage to Gravin Clothilde von Alptraum (she declined). Who? You don't stand to inherit any land or titles you, or does she know your master? Why not? Are you not nobility, or is someone else in your family going to inherit instead? One night you nearly drowned in a storm, but were saved by a fisherman named Jurgen Klinski. Now Jurgen’s wife Olga feels any compulsion to help her? Another of your messages is for Captai in Averheim. He has been referred to you by a woman on the docks named Mathilda Durbein. Now you'd like to buy it back. What was it? Does Mathilda still have it? The very first person you met in Averheim was another player character. You also have a message for another player character. Who? Do you know him or her personally? Are you and the Foreign Messenger from the homeland? Did his or her play a role in events that led to your exile? You've heard rumours that the Outcast character was exiled for dallying with a nobleman’s daughter. Do you believe the gossip?
